# Catch2

This directory contains the official Catch2 v3.15.3 amalgamated distribution:

- `catch_amalgamated.hpp`
- `catch_amalgamated.cpp`
- `LICENSE.txt`

Upstream source: <https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2/releases/tag/v3.15.3>

The version is pinned so Auto Core tests build reproducibly without requiring
contributors to install a separate C++ package manager. Update all three files
together when changing the pinned version.
